verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a community report that environment variables (NEW_RELIC_APPLICATION_LOGGING_ENABLED / ..._FORWARDING_ENABLED=false) turn off the agent's default log collection and forwarding to New Relic, which the docs confirm is on by default. That shows some control over what data the agent sends to the vendor. Nothing in the pack covers opting out of vendor usage tracking or product telemetry for the CLI, UI or AI features. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out for usage analytics and product telemetry (CLI, platform, AI assistant/MCP), first-party docs for disabling data collection, and independent corroboration.
